Name: Corners of the world
Author: ChincerDante
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod lets you pick a new farm type: Corners of the world, a larger than average map with four unique zones with your farmhouse starting at the center of it all on a plateau, you have the mountains with a quarry, a dense forest, a vast meadow and the beach, forageables all around and plenty of options for design.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]This mod requires Content patcher to function,.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]make sure your Smapi and Content patcher are up to date [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install the folder provided under "Mods" in your stardew valley folder.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Tilable grass all around.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A functioning quarry up on the mountains.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Fish is set to forest with a small chance for Ocean fish regardless of place of fishing.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]significantly more space than the vanilla farms.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]forageables spawn around the map.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]berry bushes around the map.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod requires Content patcher[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Magicalhub - Farm Map
Manifest.Description: A modified map with four unique zones each with its own advantages and a few secrets.
Manifest.Author: ChincerDante
